# v4.20

> A Nuxt starter template demo by Eco Development Studios.

The public demo has a homepage and an About page. Visitors can enter a name, view the greeting on the About page, and choose a color theme.

- [Home](https://v420.ecostudios.dev/)
- [About](https://v420.ecostudios.dev/about)
